audits.title: Course file and laboratory readiness spot check
audits.venue: Demo CET meeting room and computer laboratory LAB-IT-01
audits.objectives: Confirm readiness and delivery records for a new sample and inspect one physical syllabus approval original.
audits.scope: BSIT demo section BSIT-DEMO-3C and computer laboratory LAB-IT-01. Sample window 1–8 September 2026.

checklistItems.checkItem: Was the sampled syllabus approved before release?
checklistItems.localCriterion: Review and approve the syllabus before initial release. The chair records approval on the signed review original, and the faculty custodian logs its reference.
checklistItems.auditRemarks: Original SYL-3A-R01 was inspected. The chair endorsement dated 12 August preceded release on 13 August.

checklistItems.checkItem: Can the course file show when its approved syllabus was released?
checklistItems.localCriterion: Record the first release date and retain a retrievable release entry linked to the approved syllabus revision in the course file.
checklistItems.auditRemarks: For BSIT-DEMO-3B, the release tracker had no date and the sampled course-file folder had no retrievable release entry at audit time.

checklistItems.checkItem: Do the sampled sessions have delivery and assessment references?
checklistItems.localCriterion: Keep a delivery entry and assessment reference for each sampled teaching session. Record the session date, topic and assessment identifier.
checklistItems.auditRemarks: The 14 and 21 August BSIT-DEMO-3A entries each showed a topic and assessment identifier.

checklistItems.checkItem: Does the course-file index point to each sampled record?
checklistItems.localCriterion: Keep an index showing each course-file record and its location. The index is the locator when file names vary.
checklistItems.auditRemarks: The index located both records. Their filenames followed different patterns, which made manual sorting slower.

checklistItems.checkItem: Was the pre-use readiness entry endorsed before the lab was released?
checklistItems.localCriterion: The custodian initials and dates each completed readiness entry before the room is released. A missing endorsement keeps the record incomplete.
checklistItems.auditRemarks: The 18 August readiness entry for LAB-IT-01 showed completed checks and room release, with the custodian initials and endorsement date blank.

checklistItems.checkItem: Was maintenance completion and acceptance recorded before equipment returned to service?
checklistItems.localCriterion: Record scheduled preventive maintenance and retain dated completion and reviewer acceptance before returning an affected asset to service.
checklistItems.auditRemarks: The 19 August return-to-service entry for DEMO-PC-07 lacked a dated maintenance completion and reviewer acceptance.

checklistItems.checkItem: Was the faulty asset isolated and assigned to a follow-up owner?
checklistItems.localCriterion: Record faults by asset tag. Isolate affected equipment and assign a follow-up owner before releasing the rest of the room for use.
checklistItems.auditRemarks: DEMO-PC-12 was marked out of service and assigned to the demo lab custodian in FLT-0825-12.

checklistItems.checkItem: Was readiness recorded for the sampled September laboratory session?
checklistItems.localCriterion: Complete the readiness checklist before a scheduled lab session. Record the date, room, equipment checks and disposition of any faults.
checklistItems.auditRemarks: The LAB-IT-01 checklist was dated 8 September and recorded the workstation, network and safety checks plus the fault disposition.

checklistItems.checkItem: Does the sampled September course file include a delivery entry and an assessment reference?
checklistItems.localCriterion: Keep a delivery entry and assessment reference for each sampled teaching session. Record the session date, topic and assessment identifier.
checklistItems.auditRemarks: The 8 September BSIT-DEMO-3C entry recorded its topic and assessment identifier PRACT-03.

checklistItems.checkItem: Can the chair present the signed original for the sampled syllabus?
checklistItems.localCriterion: Review and approve the syllabus before initial release. The chair records approval on the signed review original, and the faculty custodian logs its reference.

findings.statement: The 3B course file lacked a retrievable syllabus release entry at the time of sampling.
The index was usable. Consistent filenames could make sorting easier.
The lab release entry dated 18 August lacked required custodian initials and an endorsement date.
DEMO-PC-07 was shown returned to service without a dated maintenance completion or reviewer acceptance.

correctiveActions.immediateCorrection: Recovered the 13 August LMS release event and indexed it in the 3B course file on 2 September.
correctiveActions.rootCause: The pre-release checklist assigned no one to archive release evidence.
correctiveActions.correctiveAction: Assigned the faculty custodian to index each release event and the chair to sample the release log.
correctiveActions.verificationNote: Auditor checked the recovered 3B record and a later 3C release dated 1 September. Both identified the approved revision. Team leader recorded closure.

statusHistory.note: Recorded closure after the auditor verified effectiveness.

correctiveActions.immediateCorrection: Preserved the incomplete August entry. Reviewed it with the custodian and entered the correction in the response log.
correctiveActions.rootCause: The readiness sheet allowed a room to be released with the endorsement fields blank.
correctiveActions.correctiveAction: Added a sign-off gate before room release. Submitted the 8 September entry for effectiveness review.

statusHistory.note: Submitted response CE-002. Reviewer decision is pending.
